''See also: [[Kathrin Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Kathrin is a [[Valinhall Travelers|Valinhall Traveler]] who has proven her worth by passing [[Valin]]'s tests, earning him to view her as one of his true children. She possesses the ability to summon and banish weapons, including a large [[steel]] bow and her [[Dragon's Fang]], as well as a massive mirror-bright hammer. During combat, she has been seen utilizing [[ghost armor]] and engaging in fierce battles against [[Incarnations]]. Despite her combat prowess, she has displayed a defiant and blunt personality, often expressing frustration or boredom. She is part of a group of [[Valinhall Travelers]] and was expected to provide defensive coverage for certain strategic points during an anticipated attack by [[Grandmasters]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Kathrin is an independent individual who has built her own life for herself. She refuses to approach her former master unless she is permitted to engage in a duel.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Kathrin is one of the true children of [[Valin]], having successfully passed his test. She also maintains a contentious connection to her former master, whom she refuses to approach without first engaging in a duel.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|As a [[Valinhall Travelers|Valinhall Traveler]], Kathrin is skilled at covering defense points. She has also engaged in combat against the [[Golems|golems]] of the [[Ornheim Incarnation]].}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|As one of [[Valin]]'s true children who successfully passed his test, Kathrin has established an independent life for herself. Due to trauma experienced during her youth, she was unable to make it to the camp and instead focuses her efforts on covering defense points. She refuses to approach her former master without first engaging in a duel, though she remains someone [[Kai]] might alert if she consents to return.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|As a [[Valinhall Travelers|Valinhall Traveler]], Kathrin remains alive and in possession of a [[Dragon's Fang]]. Supported by an advisor capable of long-distance communication, she engaged in combat against the [[Golems|golems]] of the [[Ornheim Incarnation]]. Following this battle in [[Elysia]], she disappeared.}}
